title: Digital Freedom Ends Here: Prepare for the ID-Only Internet
partialText: The EU and Turkey are moving to end anonymous internet access. France and Germany want mandatory digital ID (EUDI Wallet) for social media, with age-based restrictions including a full ban for under-14s. The EU targets 80% citizen adoption by 2030. Turkey will soon require ID and phone number verification for social media while banning users under 15. VPNs will be blocked. By late 2026, the free, open internet as we know it will likely be gone.

title: Prediction Markets Hit Record $6.5 Billion Week as Kalshi and Polymarket Surge
partialText:
Prediction markets recorded their strongest week on record, with total industry weekly notional volume crossing $6.5B.

Kalshi led the surge with $3.54B in volume and now controls roughly 90% of the U.S. market.

On Polymarket, 5-minute and 15-minute contracts now account for 80%+ of crypto-only volume, signaling a major market structure shift.

Fast markets are increasingly automated, with bots and high-activity addresses controlling 55–62% of volume.

Regulatory focus is shifting from legality to market integrity, insider access, and information asymmetry risks.
